title: MvFFN: Multi-view Floor plan Feed-forward Network for Unposed Wide-Baseline Panorama Layout Reconstruction
abstract: arXiv:2610.14315v2 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Reconstructing accurate camera poses and floor-plan layouts from sparse, unposed, wide-baseline RGB panoramas remains a challenging open problem. Direct multi-room floor-plan prediction is especially difficult in this setting: pose, geometry, semantics, and global layout structure are tightly coupled, yet a complete floor-plan is hard to learn as a single global output. Our key insight is to keep the model's predictions strictly local. Multi-view Ordered Wall Instance Segmentation (MOIS) is designed around this concept. Each panorama column predicts only the wall it observes plus the next two adjacent walls in clockwise order. The global wall partition, room layouts, and shared coordinates emerge from deterministic aggregation of overlapping local predictions. Building on MOIS, we propose Multi-view floor-plan Feed-Forward Network (MvFFN), which jointly predicts coarse camera poses, dense global geometry, and per-wall semantic outputs.

translated_title: MvFFN：用于无位姿宽基线全景图布局重建的多视角户型图前馈网络
translated_abstract: 从稀疏的、无位姿的、宽基线RGB全景图中重建精确的相机位姿和户型图布局，仍然是一个具有挑战性的开放问题。在这种设定下，直接进行多房间户型图预测尤为困难：位姿、几何、语义和全局布局结构紧密耦合，而完整的户型图难以作为单一的全局输出直接学习。我们的核心洞察是让模型的预测严格保持局部性。多视角有序墙体实例分割正是围绕这一理念设计的：每个全景图列仅预测它所观测到的墙体，以及按顺时针顺序接下来的两个相邻墙体。全局墙体划分、房间布局和共享坐标则通过对重叠的局部预测进行确定性聚合而自然涌现。基于MOIS，我们提出了多视角户型图前馈网络，它联合预测粗略的相机位姿、稠密的全局几何以及逐墙体的语义输出。
tldr: 提出MvFFN网络，通过让每个全景图列仅局部预测所见墙体及顺时针相邻两堵墙，再由确定性聚合成全局户型图，实现无位姿宽基线全景图中相机位姿与布局的联合重建。
en_tdlr: MvFFN jointly reconstructs camera poses and floor-plan layouts from unposed, wide-baseline panoramas by keeping predictions strictly local—each panorama column predicts only its observed wall plus the next two adjacent walls—so that global structure emerges from deterministic aggregation of overlapping local predictions.
